name: umbral
title: Umbral
description: An OpenID Connect provider that signs people in with social accounts or passkeys, no passwords.
notes: The domain is part of every callback address you register with a sign-in provider, so choose it once. On its first start Umbral writes a one-time claim code to its log (look for the box that says "not configured yet"): open the app's Logs, then https://{{domain}} and claim the instance. Everything it keeps is on one volume, which Caravana backs up every day at 03:00 UTC (the volume is the key ring: without it every secret is lost).

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Domain
inputs.help: Its DNS must point at this server. It must be the exact address people use.
